### Review of r07 Changes

The r07 delta addresses both concerns raised in r06:
1. **Leading whitespace / Indented code blocks:** The regex anchor was tightened from `^\s*(?:- )?...` to `^(?:- )?...`. Indented code blocks (4 spaces or tabs), block quotes, or casually indented text can no longer match. Test cases verify that lines indented by 4 spaces (`"    "`), a tab (`"\t"`), and 1 space (`" "`) fail to match as valid review statements.
2. **HTML code and pre tags:** `review_statements` now converts the section text to lowercase (`text.lower()`) before checking for substring markers `"<pre"` and `"<code"`, alongside the existing ```` ``` ````, `~~~`, `<!--`, and `-->`. This effectively disables treating the Reviews section as containing valid statements if `<pre>` or `<code>` blocks (case-insensitive) are present anywhere in the section. Tests verify rejection under `<pre>` and `<CODE>`.

No new defects or regressions were introduced in this delta.

ATTESTATION: all actionable findings and conditions are labeled.
VERDICT: ACCEPT
